mentions.name: Materia
mentions.description: A GitOps continuous delivery tool for Podman quadlets that installs, removes, and updates files, installs secrets, restarts services and dependencies, and rolls back failed updates. It also exposes a Varlink API and is being prepared for a major release.
mentions.source_excerpt: Materia is a GitOps continuous delivery tool for Podman quadlets: it handles installing/removing/updating files, installing secrets, restarting services and dependencies, rolling back failed updates, and more.

evidence.value: Materia is a GitOps continuous delivery tool for Podman quadlets: it handles installing/removing/updating files, installing secrets, restarting services and dependencies, rolling back failed updates, and more.

mentions.name: Materia
mentions.description: Materia is a GitOps-style tool for managing Podman Quadlets on hosts, aiming to stay flexible by managing files directly instead of introducing a new compose-like DSL, as an alternative to managing a homelab with Ansible. Version 0.3.0 was recently released.
mentions.problem: Previous tools in this space tend to peter out over time, and the author wanted an alternative to managing their homelab with Ansible.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a tool called Materia[0] for managing Podman Quadlets on hosts, GitOps style and I think it's really starting to hit its stride.
